fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: Names the single Protenix job generated from these parameters; results are written under this name.

fields.name: sequence_molecules
fields.label: Molecules
fields.help: Add one box per unique Protenix entity. Set count and an optional matching list of comma-separated chain IDs, plus the sequence, ligand (a CCD_ code such as CCD_ATP, several joined for a glycan such as CCD_NAG_BMA_BGC, a SMILES string, or FILE_ and an absolute path to a 3D structure file), or ion code (e.g. MG, without CCD_). Modifications take a CCD code at a 1-based position. "Cyclic" closes a peptide with a head-to-tail amide bond. MSA and template paths are optional precomputed files.

fields.name: covalent_bonds
fields.label: Covalent bonds (JSON, optional)
fields.help: Native Protenix covalent_bonds array, e.g. [{"entity1": "2", "copy1": 1, "position1": "2", "atom1": "N6", "entity2": "3", "copy2": 1, "position2": "1", "atom2": "C1"}]. Entities are 1-based box indexes; copies are 1-based within count and may be omitted together to bond every copy pair.

fields.name: constraint
fields.label: Constraint (JSON, optional)
fields.help: Native Protenix constraint object with a "contact" list and/or a "pocket" object, e.g. {"pocket": {"binder_chain": {"entity": 2, "copy": 1}, "contact_residues": [{"entity": 1, "copy": 1, "position": 69}], "max_distance": 8}}. A soft constraint, read only by protenix_base_constraint_v0.5.0.

fields.name: input_json
fields.label: Protenix inference jobs (JSON)
fields.help: Complete native Protenix input: a non-empty top-level list of named jobs using proteinChain, dnaSequence, rnaSequence, ligand, or ion entities, with optional covalent_bonds, constraint, and modelSeeds.
fields.help_note: Bio Web writes this text to input.json. Any MSA, template, or FILE_ ligand paths inside it must be absolute paths available to the runner.

fields.name: inputs_file
fields.label: Inference jobs file (JSON)
fields.help: The JSON file defining this run's jobs, in Protenix's own input format.
fields.help_note: Choose a file. Its contents are read here and sent as the input document.

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.help: Checkpoint to run; weights download on first use. protenix-v2 and the v1.0.0 base models add template and RNA MSA support; only protenix_base_constraint_v0.5.0 reads constraints; the mini and tiny models trade accuracy for speed (recommended: 4 cycles and 5 steps), and the ESM and ISM variants add ESM2-3B embeddings for use without MSAs. The protenix pred CLI default is protenix_base_default_v1.0.0.

fields.name: seeds
fields.label: Seeds
fields.help: Comma-separated integers passed to --seeds; every job runs once per seed. The CLI default is 101.

fields.name: use_seeds_in_json
fields.label: Use seeds from the input JSON
fields.help: Use modelSeeds from the first job in place of Seeds, for every job in the run.

fields.name: samples
fields.label: Samples
fields.help: Number of structure samples per seed (--sample). The CLI default is 5.

fields.name: cycles
fields.label: Pairformer cycles
fields.help: Number of Pairformer recycling cycles (--cycle). The CLI default is 10.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: Diffusion steps
fields.help: Number of diffusion steps (--step). The CLI default is 200.

fields.name: use_default_params
fields.label: Use the model's recommended parameters
fields.help: Replace cycles and steps with the selected model's recommended values: 10 and 200 for base models and protenix-v2, 4 and 5 for mini and tiny models. Also turns MSAs off for the mini ESM and ISM models.

fields.name: use_msa
fields.label: Use or generate protein MSAs
fields.help: Use protein MSA features. A protein without paired or unpaired MSA paths has its sequence sent to the MSA server chosen below. Turn off for private sequences or offline runs, at a significant cost in accuracy unless an ESM model is used.

fields.name: msa_server_mode
fields.label: MSA server
fields.help: Where missing protein MSAs are searched: the Protenix MSA service (https://protenix-server.com/api/msa; set MMSEQS_SERVICE_HOST_URL on the runner to use your own) or the public ColabFold MMseqs2 server (https://api.colabfold.com).

fields.name: use_template
fields.label: Use protein templates
fields.help: Use template features from each protein's templatesPath (.a3m or .hhr). A protein without one gets a local template search instead, which needs protein MSAs, HMMER (hmmsearch and hmmbuild) on the runner's PATH, and downloads the PDB seqres database on first use. Requires protenix-v2 or a v1.0.0 base model.

fields.name: use_rna_msa
fields.label: Use RNA MSAs
fields.help: Use RNA MSA features from each RNA's unpaired MSA path. An RNA without one gets a local nhmmer search instead, which needs HMMER on the runner's PATH and downloads the Rfam, RNAcentral, and NT-RNA databases on first use. Requires protein MSAs to be on, and protenix-v2 or a v1.0.0 base model.

fields.name: use_guidance
fields.label: Use training-free guidance
fields.help: Apply Training-Free Guidance (--use_tfg_guidance) for improved ligand plausibility, such as chirality and planarity; increases compute time.

fields.name: need_atom_confidence
fields.label: Write atom-level confidence data
fields.help: Write full per-atom confidence JSON in addition to each sample's summary confidence.

fields.name: dtype
fields.label: Inference precision
fields.help: Protenix defaults to BF16; FP32 uses more memory.

fields.name: triatt_kernel
fields.label: Triangle attention kernel
fields.help: Kernel for triangle attention. DeepSpeed needs DeepSpeed and CUTLASS_PATH on the runner; PyTorch needs no extra kernels.

fields.name: trimul_kernel
fields.label: Triangle multiplicative kernel
fields.help: Kernel for the triangle multiplicative update.

fields.name: enable_cache
fields.label: Cache diffusion variables
fields.help: Cache shareable variables in the diffusion module.

fields.name: enable_fusion
fields.label: Kernel fusion
fields.help: Enable efficient kernel fusion in the diffusion transformer.

fields.name: enable_tf32
fields.label: TF32 matrix multiplication
fields.help: Enable TF32 for FP32 matrix multiplications on supported GPUs.
